description.value: Pepper's Foods is a 100% locally owned, full-service supermarket anchoring the Cadboro Bay Village neighbourhood of Victoria, with departments spanning bakery, deli, meat, seafood, produce, and floral. The store has a strong emphasis on Island-sourced products and has won Gold Medal recognition as Best Grocery Store in both BC and Canada two years running. The deli serves hot food daily including breakfast sandwiches, paninis, and BBQ chicken, making it a solid resupply stop for touring cyclists.
